reviews.title: Good memory at a better price.
reviews.comment: I used this to upgrade a Lenovo desktop and all went smoothly. The memory was instantly recognized in Windows and the BIOS and at a better price. I’ve purchased KLEVV memory to upgrade several systems and haven’t had any issues or bad DIMM’s.
reviews.author: Marshall Carter

reviews.title: KLEVV has earned my business in the future, whatever the market does.
reviews.comment: I got more "old" DDR4 just in case my existing sticks experienced a failure, and I did not want to replace them in a supply crunch.  So I am pretty happy with KLEVV / SK Hynix? who provided what they promised, even while the market price was exploding.  Unlike some other vendors... So KLEVV has earned my business in the future, whatever the market does.
reviews.author: Eric H
